content.short: Sentry is a DeFi monitoring tool by Aleno that helps asset managers monitor risks in assets and positions.
content.description: Sentry is a fast, powerful DeFi monitoring system designed for DeFi Asset Managers. It lets you oversee the risk exposure of assets and positions held at a specific address, with data continuously sourced and updated for the related assets. By continuously tracking holdings and position changes, Sentry provides timely visibility into risk profiles, empowering proactive decision‑making and safer asset management across your linked addresses. This focused monitoring helps you stay on top of evolving risk as markets move.
content.meta: Sentry is a powerful and swift DeFi monitoring system tailored for DeFi Asset Managers. Discover Sentry and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
